assertions.assertion: No client uses GrantTypes.Implicit and no client has RequirePkce = false
assertions.rationale: spa.legacy migrated to GrantTypes.Code with RequirePkce = true; web.app RequirePkce set to true. No implicit flow or disabled PKCE remains.

assertions.assertion: No redirect URI contains wildcard characters (* or regex patterns)
assertions.rationale: web.app wildcard URIs replaced with exact https://app.example.com/... URIs.

assertions.assertion: AddDeveloperSigningCredential is removed and replaced with automatic key management or proper signing credentials
assertions.rationale: Removes AddDeveloperSigningCredential and enables KeyManagement (RotationInterval, DataProtectKeys).

assertions.assertion: All access token lifetimes are 900 seconds or less for interactive clients
assertions.rationale: web.app and spa.legacy set to 300; native.app already 300. M2M clients retain 3600, which the assertion excludes as non-interactive.

assertions.assertion: The output includes a summary or explanation listing the security issues found and how they were remediated
assertions.rationale: Provides a numbered list of 10 findings with fixes plus a closing summary paragraph.
